story.value: Actinium was discovered by Andre Debierne in 1899, and independently by F. Giesel in 1902.
The name actinium comes from the Greek words aktis and aktinos, meaning beam or ray.
Debierne discovered actinium while he was experimenting with new methods of separating rare earth oxides.

uses.value: Actinium is used in the production of neutrons.
Actinium has no significant commercial applications.
